newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV IDLES AT 1,500 TO DLR ON DORMANT MKT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV IDLES AT 1,500 TO DLR ON DORMANT MKT.

text.p: 1,499-1,502 per dollar in very thin interbank volume on
Saturday morning, virtually flat from Friday's close at
1,501-1,502, on a dormant local interbank market, dealers said.
"Trade is almost non-existent as markets abroad are closed.
There are sporadic deals for small foreign currency volumes
around 1,499-1,502 levs per dollar," one dealer said.
Local markets were open on Saturday following a long
holiday for Orthodox Easter and Labour day last week.
The lev traded at 887-890 per mark, tracking late Friday's
Dealers said trade was expected to be confined to low
volumes by the end of the day as no large final clients were
likely to bid or offer foreign currency on the market.
